Über Babauba
Babauba ist eine Love Brand für farbenfrohe Kindermode. Wir haben die Marke im September 2025 übernommen und relauncht. Wir produzieren in Europa: in einer Produktion mit einem Team aus Müttern, die um 15 Uhr gehen, um ihre eigenen Kinder abzuholen. Wir stehen gegen den Beige-Trend, gegen Fast Fashion, gegen Marketing-Bullshit. Wir stehen für: bunte Kleidung, ehrliche Kommunikation und eine Community, die etwas bewegt.
Was uns als Arbeitgeber ausmacht
Bei uns gibt es einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung/Inhaber, keine Konzern-Hierarchie, keine Marketing-Meetings die aus Marketing-Meetings entstehen. Wir arbeiten mit einer echten Community aus 200.000 Menschen, die aktiv mit uns kommunizieren, nicht für eine anonyme Zielgruppe. Wir schätzen kreative Freiheit über Corporate-Rituale und schauen was wirklich funktioniert, nicht was auf Slides gut aussieht.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgabe
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unser Meta-Ads-Setup und optimierst es systematisch. Konkret bedeutet das:
Tägliches Monitoring und Optimierung unserer Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp)
Aufbau einer strukturierten Test-Logik mit Ad Sets, Hook-Varianten und Building Blocks
Analyse von Backend-KPIs (Profit, Neukunden, CAC, ROAS) und nicht nur Vanity-Metriken
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren UGC-Creators und dem Kreativ-Team (Sebi, Christina, Jack)
Wettbewerbs-Analyse: Was macht die Konkurrenz? Was können wir daraus lernen?
Reporting an die Geschäftsführung: ehrlich, ohne Schönfärberei
Qualifikation
Was du mitbringen solltest
Mindestens 2-3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Meta Ads (in-house oder Agentur)
Ein tiefes Verständnis für D2C-E-Commerce und die dazugehörigen KPIs
Analytisches Denken, aber auch ein Gefühl für kreative Ads und Hooks
Erfahrung mit Shopify ist ein Plus
Deutschkenntnisse verhandlungssicher, Englischkenntnisse fließend
Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: wir brauchen niemanden, der Micromanagement braucht.

Was wir bieten
Eine Marke mit klarer Haltung und einer engagierten Community (200.000 Follower)
Direkter Draht zum Geschäftsführer/Inhaber: keine Konzern-Hierarchie
Home-Office / Remote möglich (Bayern bevorzugt für gelegentliche Treffen)
Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (mindestens 30h/Woche)
Faire Vergütung je nach Erfahrung
Flache Strukturen und die Chance, wirklich etwas mit aufzubauen
Kein Meta-Bullshit-Bingo: bei uns zählt, was funktioniert
So bewirbst du dich
Schick uns keinen klassischen Lebenslauf. Schreib uns stattdessen einen kurzen Text (max. eine Seite), in dem du folgende drei Fragen beantwortest:
Was war der beste Meta-Test, den du je gemacht hast, und warum hat er funktioniert?
Was war der schlimmste Fehler, den du bei Meta Ads gemacht hast, und was hast du daraus gelernt?
Wenn du drei Wochen bei Babauba arbeitest, was wären die ersten drei Dinge, die du dir anschauen würdest?
Wir lesen alle Bewerbungen selbst. Patrick antwortet dir persönlich.

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.
Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.
You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).
This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.
Tasks
Your core mandate sits on three priorities.
1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health
Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.
2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation
Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.
3. Benchmark Reports and Growth
This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.
4. PPC Management and Optimization
Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Over the last two years, consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated fast. We’ve grown our B2C activity significantly, and we’re now looking for someone brilliant to take day-to-day ownership of our digital performance engine.
This is a hands-on role for someone who loves being close to the detail: building campaigns, digging into search query reports, spotting optimisation opportunities, improving audiences, testing creative, reporting clearly, and helping us move faster.
You’ll sit in the B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and will own paid digital activity across paid search, programmatic and paid social. You’ll work closely with our Content Creator, Design team, Commercial team and wider Marketing team to get campaigns live quickly, optimise performance, and unlock new areas of growth.
Paid media is the heart of this role, but you'll also own key parts of the user journey, including writing, building, and launching campaign landing pages using our web tools to ensure end-to-end performance. Over time, there may also be the opportunity to support organic social planning, scheduling, and reporting alongside our Content Creator.
This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally from an agency or fast-paced digital environment, who is ready to step into an in-house role with more ownership, more visibility, and more chance to shape what happens next.

🚀 Own our paid digital channels: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across paid search, paid social and programmatic display, helping us reach more people ready to make the switch to electric.
🔍 Get properly stuck into the detail: Dive into search query reports, audiences, bids, budgets and campaign performance to spot what’s working, what’s wasting spend, and where the next opportunity is.
🔧 Keep the digital engine humming: Work hands-on across SA360, DV360, Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, making sure campaigns are set up cleanly, tracking works, audiences flow through, and everything goes live without drama.
📈 Spend smartly: Help manage digital spend within agreed monthly targets, reporting regularly on pacing, CPL and performance, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause or test next.
🧪 Test, learn, repeat: Partner with our Content Creator and Design team to test new creative hooks, formats, audiences and messaging across paid search, paid social and programmatic.
📊 Make reporting actually useful: Turn channel data into clear, practical insight, helping the B2C squad understand what’s happening, why, and what we should do next.
🌐 Own landing page launches & web optimisations: Take end-to-end ownership when campaigns require new landing pages and other pieces of content like quizzes, drafting page copy (with support from the team), building them using our CMS/web tools, and setting them live.
🤝 Make things happen: Coordinate briefs, assets, links, tracking and launches across content, design, web and wider marketing teams so campaigns get live quickly and with as little faff as possible. You’ll also be happy jumping into wider growth priorities when the team needs it.
What you'll need
Strong experience of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in a fast-paced agency, media, content or high-growth in-house environment. We’re open on exact years of experience - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.
Strong paid search experience, with the confidence to build, manage and optimise campaigns day to day, including search query analysis, bid optimisation, budget pacing and performance reporting.
Experience with Google Marketing Platform, especially SA360 and Campaign Manager. DV360 experience would be a big plus, particularly if you’ve worked on programmatic display campaigns.
Experience managing paid social campaigns, ideally in Meta Ads Manager, with a good understanding of how creative, audiences, placements and formats affect performance.
A proper performance mindset. You enjoy digging into the numbers, finding wasted spend, spotting growth opportunities and working out what we should do next.
Good tracking and reporting hygiene. You understand why UTMs, conversion tracking, audiences, naming conventions and clean campaign setup matter.
A roll-your-sleeves-up attitude. We move quickly, things change, and there’s always something new to figure out. You’ll enjoy this role if you like pace, variety, ownership, and the odd “this isn’t technically my job, but I can help” moment.
This role will suit someone driven, proactive and commercially minded, but also kind, low-ego, positive and fun to work with

For years, account-based marketing at Fresh Prints has been built around campaigns. We identify an opportunity, launch a program, measure the results, and rebuild the approach the following year. That is no longer enough.
Our highest-value accounts should not be managed as a series of campaigns. They need a long-term growth strategy: a clear view of which accounts deserve disproportionate investment, what will materially change their value, and how Fresh Prints should serve, retain, and expand them over time. Your job will be to build that strategy.
You will bring together customer insights, data, segmentation, and operational execution to determine where the biggest account growth opportunities exist and what the business must do to capture them. The goal is to build an account-growth system that becomes more intelligent, more effective, and more valuable with every cycle.
There is no established function to inherit and no finished playbook to manage. You will define what account-based marketing should mean for Fresh Prints, build the operating model behind it, and drive the business to execute against it across Marketing, Sales, Creative, Data, and Operations.
We are not looking for someone who will optimize the existing approach at the margins. We are looking for someone who will question its assumptions, identify the few bets that could materially change account value, and take responsibility for turning those bets into results.

Defining how Fresh Prints grows and retains its most valuable accounts at the company level, not simply running better campaigns.
Building an account strategy that continues to work as chapters, decision-makers, relationships, and buying cycles change.
Identifying the few highest-leverage bets that could materially increase account value, then focusing the business around them.
Turning strategy into execution through direct ownership, cross-functional influence, and systems that scale.
Shaping how Marketing, Sales, Operations, and account-facing teams approach retention, expansion, and long-term account development.
Building account growth into a durable business capability, not an initiative that resets every campaign cycle.
What You'll Own
Company-Level Account Strategy
Build the long-term growth strategy for Fresh Prints’ highest-value accounts.
Define how the business should identify, segment, prioritise, invest in, retain, and expand those accounts over time.
Develop a strategy that remains effective even as student leaders, decision-makers, buying committees, and internal account owners change.
Use customer insight, account data, and commercial judgment to identify the few opportunities that could materially change account value across the business.
Shape decisions across sales motions, customer experience, and account coverage when those decisions are necessary to unlock growth.
Turning Strategy Into Results
Take responsibility for moving the strategy from an idea into how the company actually operates.
This is not a role that ends with recommendations, presentations, or campaign briefs. You will stay close enough to execution to ensure the strategy produces measurable results.
Use AI, automation, process, and disciplined prioritisation to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.
Partner with Sales, BDM, Campus Manager leadership, Marketing, Creative, Data, and Operations to translate the strategy into clear actions, ownership, and operating rhythms.
Build the systems, decision rules, and playbooks that allow teams to execute the strategy correctly without depending on you to manage every action.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Represent account growth and retention in executive-level conversations.
Bring a clear, evidence-backed point of view on where the company should place its bets, what it should stop doing, and what needs to change.
Build the commercial case and organisational support required to secure resources, change priorities, and influence how teams operate.
Raise the quality of thinking and execution across teams you do not formally manage through clarity, judgment, and credibility.
Measure success through changes in retention, expansion, and account value, not simply through campaign delivery or short-term engagement metrics.

You think in systems, not isolated campaigns, and build strategies that outlast any individual relationship or decision-maker.
You have created a meaningful step-change in performance before, not only improved an established playbook at the margins.
You are comfortable entering an ambiguous problem, forming a strong point of view, and creating the path forward without precedent.
You can move from customer insight and data to clear strategic choices, then stay close enough to execution to make those choices real.
You know how to raise the performance of teams you do not manage through strong judgment, clear systems, and influence rather than formal authority.
You have the credibility to challenge assumptions, influence senior leaders, and push the business toward harder but higher-value decisions.
You take retention and expansion as seriously as acquisition and see all three as part of the same account-growth system.

5+ years of experience in account-based marketing, growth strategy, customer strategy, revenue strategy, or a related strategic role.
A track record of delivering significant, measurable improvements in account growth, retention, expansion, or customer value.
Evidence of building a new strategy, capability, or operating model rather than only managing an established function.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect customer insight, data, and business economics.
Experience driving meaningful outcomes across teams without relying on formal authority.
Strong executive communication, including presenting recommendations, challenging assumptions, and securing senior-level buy-in.
Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction without precedent, and being accountable for results without an established playbook.

Strategic thinker with excellent project management and organizational skills.

Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
Resourceful, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences.
Self-starter who takes ownership and drives projects to completion.

About Pair Team
Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. As an AI-enabled medical group for Medicaid and Medicare, we deliver medical, behavioral, and social care by integrating shelters, pantries and other community-based organizations into our whole-person model.

As California’s largest complex care provider, we’ve proven our impact to reduce avoidable emergency care, including a 52% and 26% reduction in ER visits and hospitalizations respectively. Once scaled nationally, our approach would save tax payers $150B per year.
With our years of experience and vast data collected, we are now building an AI platform that embeds social work agents across the safety net to truly unify our fragmented healthcare and welfare system. By scaling our country’s frontline medical and social services workforce, we aim to bring high-touch care to everyone.
At Pair Team , we’re not just delivering care—we’re transforming it. We’re building a future where high-touch, community-driven care is accessible to everyone, especially the most underserved.

About the Opportunity
As Director of Product Marketing, you will own how Pair Team connects its product to the people we serve. You sit at the intersection of product, growth, and the patient across our service lines and programs within Medicaid and Medicare and you own the work that turns a powerful care platform into patients who enroll, engage, and stay. You are the voice of the patient inside the company and the voice of the product in the market.
This is a hands-on role for someone who loves both the craft and the evidence behind it. You will build a deep, research-backed understanding of who our patients are and what they need, translate it into sharp positioning and messaging, and turn that into the welcome, onboarding, and lifecycle experiences that drive activation and retention.

You will own the message architecture that our paid media, brand, care teams, and AI care advocate all draw from, and you will raise the bar on every patient-facing touchpoint.
You will be the two-way bridge between product and patient, translating what we build into language that resonates, and carrying patient insight and friction back into the roadmap so that we build the right things.

You will partner closely with Product and Growth on go-to-market for new features and service lines, with Performance Marketing and Brand & Creative on the positioning and creative that lift conversion and lower acquisition cost, and with Clinical and Operations on patient experience and satisfaction.

You will protect compliance and patient trust at every step.
This is a fully remote position reporting to the SVP of Growth & Marketing.

Patient & Market Insight
Build a deep, continuously refreshed understanding of our patients and members across Medicaid and Medicare — who they are, what they need, and what moves them to enroll, engage, and stay.
Own audience segmentation and voice-of-patient research, both qualitative and quantitative, and synthesize it into clear, actionable insight the whole company can use.
Track the competitive and category landscape and translate it into how we position and differentiate.
Positioning, Messaging & Narrative
Own Pair Team ’s patient-facing positioning and value propositions across service lines, and the message architecture that paid media, brand, the care team, and our AI care advocate all draw from as a single source of truth.
Craft messaging that resonates with real people — clear, human, and tested — and the narratives that make Pair Team easy to choose and easy to trust.
Develop messaging and packaging for new audiences, programs, and markets as we expand.
Patient Experience & Lifecycle Marketing
Own and elevate the patient journey end to end — welcome kits, onboarding, after-visit communications, and re-engagement — so more patients activate and stay engaged.
Design lifecycle and member-communication programs across channels, partnering with Care and Operations to make every touchpoint feel personal and supportive.
Treat activation and retention as products to be improved, not one-off campaigns to be run.
Product Partnership & Go-to-Market
Serve as the two-way bridge between product and patient: translate Flora (our AI care advocate), Arc, and patient-facing experiences into clear patient language and assets.
Carry patient insight, objections, and friction back into the product roadmap so we build what patients actually need.
Lead go-to-market for new patient-facing features and service-line launches, end to end.
Partner with Performance Marketing and Brand & Creative to lift conversion across the funnel — landing pages, intake flows, creative, social proof, and bilingual experiences.
Run message and creative testing with statistical discipline, and define how product marketing’s impact is measured across conversion, activation, retention, and message performance.
Build the feedback loops that turn results into sharper messaging, better experiences, and clearer roadmap signal.
What You’ll Need
6+ years in product or lifecycle marketing, including direct ownership of positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for a product or service.
A proven track record of turning customer or audience insight into positioning and messaging that measurably moved conversion, activation, or retention.
Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills — audience research, segmentation, and message testing — and the ability to synthesize them into a clear narrative.
Excellent writing and storytelling; you can make complex things simple and write for real people, not just buyers.
Experience partnering closely with product and design to shape a roadmap and launch new features or experiences.
Comfort with data and measurement — funnel metrics, A/B testing, and cohort and retention thinking — and fluency partnering with analytics.
Experience operating in early-stage, high-growth environments with high ambiguity, minimal process, and direct accountability for outcomes.
A systems mindset — you improve outcomes with better research, messaging, and repeatable workflows, not just more output.
Deep alignment with Pair Team ’s mission and a commitment to advancing equitable care for underserved communities.

Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.
We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.
Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination.
🛠️ The Digital Marketing Team @ Bloom & Wild Group
The digital marketing team is responsible for driving sustainable growth in all of the markets we operate in through the execution of innovative, creative and measurable campaigns.
You’ll work on paid search campaigns targeting both new and existing customers, working across both our acquisition and retention teams to drive growth across multiple markets, brands and categories.
The wider team works collaboratively with internal stakeholders including brand, international, data, and product, while directly managing our external search agency to surface crucial insights and maximize campaign performance.

Own paid search strategy: lead paid search strategy, developing and executing campaigns across UK, DE, NL and other markets, ensuring alignment with wider marketing, brand and business goals – in particular, supporting Bloom & Wild Group's positioning as a gifting brand, not just selling flowers but also hampers, home, food & drink and more.
Own the budget: manage our search budget end-to-end, tracking CAC, LTV and retention costs (RC) to guide investment decisions.
Lead our agency partner : Oversee and manage third-party agency partner to execute high-performing campaigns and maximize ROI. Hold the agency accountable to performance targets, strict SLAs, and industry best practices, ensuring they continuously push the boundaries of modern search strategy by adopting cutting-edge tactics, beta programs, and new platform features.
Set the optimisation approach: set the keyword strategy, ad copy testing and audience-targeting approach that agency partners and stakeholders execute against, driving Quality Score, CTR and conversion efficiency.
Own App Campaigns: oversee Google App Campaigns and Apple Search Ads to drive installs and engagement, aligned to our retention and LTV goals.
Manage the Google relationship: work with our Google account manager to unlock alpha/beta opportunities, escalate issues and secure strategic support, along with our agency.
Own feed & process: own and continuously improve product feeds and backend processes for Google Shopping and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns.
Shape the roadmap: turn channel performance and data into clear, actionable insights that shape the wider paid media roadmap and forecasting, using Tableau and in-platform reporting.
Stay ahead of the platform: stay up to date with best practices and market insights, particularly with Google, to prepare for upcoming changes, test new features and champion the latest innovations.
Champion AI in search: maintain deep, practical knowledge of modern AI within search engine marketing – platform-level generative AI features, algorithmic updates and LLM-driven search behaviours – and share what you learn with the wider marketing team.
Be the go-to expert: act as the go-to person for paid search across the marketing team – mentoring junior colleagues, sharing learnings (e.g. through Lunch & Learns) and giving constructive feedback on paid search work outside your direct remit.
Protect share of voice: proactively monitor the competitor landscape, ensuring market share of voice, especially through peak trading moments.
✅ You’ll love this role if you…
Are an expert in Google Paid Search: You have extensive, hands-on experience managing Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns at scale (experience with Microsoft Advertising or App Campaigns is a bonus).
Are fluent in tracking and analytics: You are comfortable working with analytics tools, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center, and feel confident navigating privacy- and consent-driven changes to measurement.
Love data and reporting: You are a data-driven decision-maker who thrives on deriving insights. You are comfortable using both in-platform tools and Tableau to analyze performance across our custom-built, proprietary e-commerce stack (non-Shopify).
Have agency management experience: You have a proven track record of managing third-party agencies to drive results and maintain strategic alignment.
Are proactive and hands-on: You take full responsibility and initiative to get things done, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in.
Are structured and organized: You take a thoughtful approach to planning, organization, and prioritizing your work to deliver on key business goals.
Are curious and adaptable: You love figuring out new tech, testing, learning, and trying new things, often taking the initiative to optimize and improve existing processes.
These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a highly collaborative role, and a great fit for someone who has run events of different shapes and sizes before, and thrives at the intersection of creativity and analytics: equally energized by dreaming up a standout booth or an intimate dinner experience, and digging into the data to prove its impact.

You'll also need a finger on the pulse of what's happening in the world and in our industry, since that awareness shapes what makes an event or activation feel timely and relevant rather than generic.
This is an individual contributor role and will be expected to operate with strong ownership, sound judgment, professionalism, and great attention to detail.

Independently manage and/or support the day-to-day planning and logistics for an assigned slate of trade shows, conferences, sponsored events, and field marketing experiences (happy hours, dinners, small experiential activations), from initial sourcing through on-site execution and breakdown
Run on-site execution, including booth or venue setup/breakdown, staffing schedules, registration, speaking engagement logistics, and troubleshooting in real time when plans change
Ideate and produce at-event activations, booth experiences, and on-site moments that drive engagement and make Boulevard stand out, staying closely attuned to what's happening in the market, in culture, and in the beauty and wellness industry so every concept feels timely and on-brand
Own your assigned events as a full-funnel marketing channel, project-managing the pre- and post-event campaigns (invites, email, social, follow-up) that drive awareness, attendance, and engagement, and supporting lead capture and follow-up workflows with Sales and Marketing Operations
Share input and recommendations on which events and field marketing opportunities we prioritize, based on what you're seeing in the market, past performance, and conversations with organizers and attendees, informing calendar decisions
Build and manage detailed project timelines and checklists in Asana, and own pre- and post-event internal communications
Manage budgets, the contract/invoice process, and inventory of trade show collateral, signage, swag, and reusable event assets across the calendar, flagging risks or overages early
Track and report on the performance of your events, including post-event recaps, leads, pipeline, and ROI, and be accountable for tying results back to business impact
Build relationships with event organizers, vendors, and on-site partners, and represent Boulevard professionally with prospects and customers at every event
Travel to support on-site execution (approximately 20-30% of the time), including some weekends
What You'll Need To Thrive
3-5 years of experience supporting the logistics and on-site execution of trade shows, conferences, and/or field marketing events (dinners, happy hours, small activations), including vendor coordination, contracts, and budgets, ideally for a B2B SaaS, technology, beauty, or wellness company
A genuine pulse on culture and industry trends, with the creative instinct to translate that into memorable, on-brand experiences, whether a trade show booth or an intimate dinner
Exposure to pre- and post-event marketing campaigns, and experience tracking and reporting on leads, pipeline, and ROI and tying it back to business goals
Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects and timelines, ideally using a project management tool like Asana
Calm under pressure and quick to problem-solve when on-site logistics don't go according to plan
Comfortable representing Boulevard in person and building relationships with vendors, customers, and prospects
Experience working in a CRM such as Salesforce for lead and data tracking
Curious about using AI to work smarter, whether that's speeding up planning, reporting, or content, and excited to build it into how you approach the role
How We Will Take Care of You
At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. The anticipated base salary range is $72,000 - $85,000 per year.

In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline.
Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare.

On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so.

Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here .
For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets.

It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels).
If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you!
What you’ll be responsible for in this role
Partner with Ben to define our EMEA enterprise ABM strategy and the channels we bet on with consideration to broader global strategy and nuances of respective European markets. Here you play the critical role of orchestrator, pulling together all of the relevant marketing channels to support a delightful discovery and prospect journey and are the point person for your counterparts in Sales.
Research and build prospect journey maps for target accounts, and develop the messaging, content, and creative that bring them to life, with support from our PMM, content, and creative teams.
Work with sales and revenue operations to build target account lists that combine data signals with rep input, and own the methodology behind them — how cohorts are built, what assumptions they rest on, and how we measure whether accounts are actually moving.
Manage our agency partners, including our gifting agency, Wildcard, to get campaigns executed well and fast.
Execute on the strategy you define which will include activities like working with your events counterpart on the coordination of dinners, activations , ancillary conference events, and stunts.
Apply our experimentation framework to run short sprints, learn quickly what works, and localise content, creative, and campaign strategy for EMEA markets.

s.h: You will probably love this role if
s.t:
You enjoy combining data and creative thinking — and you have taste. You can tell the difference between messaging that's genuinely compelling and messaging that's generic or cheesy.
You're prospect-obsessed. You can step into the seat of the personas you're marketing to and build campaigns that meet them where they are, at the right time, with the right message.
You are deeply curious and not afraid to break from traditional ABM playbooks.
You build trust across functions. Sales managers and reps are excited to work with you, and the marketing team is fully bought into your campaign ideas and asks.
You understand (and leverage) the massive advantage AI creates but not so pilled that you let efficiency gains undercut creativity and taste.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You'd rely solely on 6sense (or equivalent) as your only source of truth.
You're strong on one half of the job but not the other. You need to move comfortably between building and interpreting dashboards, and writing compelling copy and developing creative with our gifting agency and creative teams.
You lean heavily on existing playbooks and tactics rather than stepping back and thinking from first principles. A lot of how we market at Ashby is deliberately different; curiosity and adaptability are critical.
You aren't able to operate with autonomy and run strategies end-to-end. We give clear ownership and trust you with it; you should be proactive and resourceful.
You believe that EMEA is one homogeneous market
Interview Plan
At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via project working sessions. Our interview process is five rounds:
30-minute intro call with Michelle (Recruiting).
45-minute interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager).
45-minute interview with Ben (US lead on ABM).
A take-home assignment, which you’ll have 40 mins to discuss with the hiring team.
A virtual on-site of 1.5 hours with a panel of interviewers.
Nhi (Strategic Projects Lead)
Casper (Head of ENT Sales, EMEA)
Antonio (AI & Automations Lead, Demand Gen)

Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
10-year exercise window for stock options . You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it .
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Du denkst nicht nur bis zum Regal – sondern bis zum Kunden.
Marketing kann schöne Bilder produzieren.
Du weißt aber: Gute Arbeit entsteht dann, wenn Produkte, Märkte, Kunden und Vertrieb wirklich zusammenkommen.
Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.
Bei Simpson Strong-Tie entwickeln wir Lösungen, die dabei helfen, Gebäude sicherer, stärker und langlebiger zu machen. Hinter unseren Produkten steckt jede Menge Engineering, Know-how und der Anspruch, Dinge kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Aufgaben
Damit aus starken Ideen und durchdachten Lösungen echte Markterfolge werden, suchen wir dich als Regional Marketing Manager (m/w/d) .
Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle zwischen Produktmanagement, Marketing und Vertrieb – und bekommst den Raum, Themen nicht einfach nur zu verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.
Was dich bei uns erwartet
Du bist nicht „nur Marketing“.
Du bist auch nicht „nur Produktmanagement“.
Du verbindest beides.
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team, dem Vertrieb und unseren europäischen Kolleginnen und Kollegen entwickelst du Ideen und Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte und unsere Marke im deutschen Markt nach vorne bringen.

Du entwickelst unsere lokale Produkt- und Marketingstrategie weiter und machst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.
Du behältst unser Produktportfolio im Blick, erkennst Potenziale und bringst neue Produkte erfolgreich in den Markt.
Du entwickelst Go-to-Market-Pläne, Kampagnen und Kommunikationsmaßnahmen, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern Wirkung zeigen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Sales zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Marketing und Vertrieb wirklich an einem Strang ziehen.
Du verantwortest Trade-Marketing-Aktivitäten – von Aktionen und Events bis hin zu Messen und kundenorientierten Maßnahmen.
Du entwickelst unsere Markenkommunikation über verschiedene Touchpoints hinweg weiter.
Du arbeitest mit externen Agenturen und Partnern zusammen und steuerst Projekte eigenverantwortlich.
Du planst und verantwortest dein Budget.
Du führst und entwickelst dein Team und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem gute Ideen entstehen können.
Du bist Teil eines internationalen Netzwerks und arbeitest eng mit unseren europäischen Teams zusammen.
Kurz gesagt: Du verbindest Strategie mit Umsetzung und Ideen mit Wirkung.
Qualifikation
Was du mitbringen solltest
Du musst nicht in jede einzelne Box passen.
Aber du solltest Lust darauf haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge voranzutreiben.

Mindestens drei Jahre Führungserfahrung und mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Marketing oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion.
Erfahrung darin, Produkte und Marken strategisch weiterzuentwickeln und gleichzeitig operativ ins Doing zu kommen.
Ein gutes Verständnis für Märkte, Kunden und Vertriebsstrukturen.
Erfahrung mit Go-to-Market-Strategien, Produkteinführungen und Marketingkampagnen.
Ein analytisches Mindset und die Fähigkeit, aus Daten und Marktinformationen gute Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
Freude an Zusammenarbeit über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg.
Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Menschen für eine Idee zu gewinnen.
Ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Marketing, Wirtschaft, Engineering oder einem ähnlichen Umfeld.
Hervorragende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Bau-, Handwerks- oder Industriebranche ist hilfreich – aber nicht alles.
Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du neugierig bist, Zusammenhänge verstehst und Lust hast, etwas zu bewegen.

Was dich bei Simpson Strong-Tie erwartet
Wir sind ein internationales Unternehmen mit einer klaren Mission: Lösungen entwickeln, die das Bauen sicherer und besser machen.
Und gleichzeitig sind wir überzeugt: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen nicht durch starre Hierarchien oder endlose Abstimmungsschleifen.
Sondern durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen dürfen.
Die Fragen stellen.
Die Ideen haben.
Und die den Mut haben, Dinge auch einmal anders zu machen.

Raum für Gestaltung
Du übernimmst eine Rolle mit echtem Einfluss auf Produkt, Marke und Marktentwicklung.
Ein starkes Team
Du arbeitest mit Menschen zusammen, die ihr Handwerk verstehen – im Marketing genauso wie im Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und Engineering.
Internationales Umfeld
Du bist lokal nah am Markt und gleichzeitig Teil eines europäischen und globalen Netzwerks.
Produkte mit Substanz
Wir verkaufen keine kurzfristigen Trends. Unsere Lösungen tragen dazu bei, Gebäude und Konstruktionen sicherer und stärker zu machen.
Entwicklung statt Stillstand
Wir wollen besser werden – als Unternehmen und als Menschen. Deshalb bekommst du die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Egal, ob dein Lebenslauf exakt diesem Profil entspricht oder dein Weg etwas anders aussieht: Wenn du denkst, dass du mit deiner Erfahrung, deiner Energie und deinen Ideen gut zu uns passt, dann bewirb dich.
Let’s build something stronger. Together.

Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere , einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert . Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo .
Deine Mission Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.
Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.
Das bringst du mit Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.
Wie wir arbeiten Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten , einstellen und wachsen : Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun. Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen. Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.
Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.
...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.
...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.
...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.
...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.
Why Aampere? Startup Umfeld : jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren Persönliches Wachstum : Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen Tech : Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.

Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket : healthy team, happy team Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats) Offsite : bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?

Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.
Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam. Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

What we do.
Imagine every product on the internet, instantly available to you.
You could take anything from any online shop, resell it, and earn from it . Every influencer could sell the products they already use and love , without ever touching a warehouse. You could spend your Payback points or miles on something you actually want , instead of another forgettable knife set. And your AI could buy any product in the world for you, without your intervention .
We built exactly that. It's live, and it's running today.
Joy_'s AI infrastructure runs the entire e-commerce value chain end to end : sourcing, checkout, payment, fulfillment, customer care, and returns. Across any online shop on the planet. No merchant contracts, no APIs, no closed networks. This is our Universal Purchasing Infrastructure , and it sits right at the center of where AI commerce is going.
On top of it, we build our own business models. The first one live and proven: the gift card .
That's a 20 billion euro market in Germany alone , the single most-gifted thing in the country, and nobody has innovated on it in years. Now there's a gift card you can redeem for any product, from any shop, for any wish .
We've raised from top European funds and angels who've built and scaled some of the most relevant tech and commerce companies around.
Behind it all: a mixed team of twelve, spread across Europe, with a strong center and our office in Berlin.
The technology is done. What we need now is the other half: the narrative, the brand, the story that makes people feel it. That's the job.
Aufgaben

In short: You own the feeling people get in the first 10 seconds. The instant, can't-look-away pull of an Oatly or TrueFruits ad, but for gifting.
This is the rare shot at building a category-defining brand from zero, the kind a whole country ends up recognizing. Everything below serves that.
And to be clear about the shape of the work: you're fluent with data. You read the dashboards and you know exactly what each channel converts. But creation comes first. What we're really hiring for is the instinct to make something loud, something the whole country notices. You build campaigns end to end, from the idea that stops the scroll to the dashboard that proves it worked.
Build the new narrative and positioning. With completely new technology we've lifted the gift card to a whole new level. Your job: tell that story, set us apart from every other gift card, and own the narrative for the new alternative.
Tell the product story. Our card is so good it reads as too good to be true. You make it believable, playing on our "Zu-Gut-Schein" framing, the gift card that's almost too good, and always making clear how it actually works.
Own our two biggest growth channels: TV and Social. This is where we scale. TV and Out of Home put your work in front of millions, on screens and billboards a whole country walks past, and on the retail shelves the card sits on. On Social, you run our own channels plus a TikTok UGC engine that multiplies everything we make.

What you ship isn't a small post for a small feed. When you get it right, a whole country sees it. We start national, but international is already on the map: UK and US are the planned next step, and the brand you build needs to travel.
Hold brand consistency. Narrative and story run through everything we ship, verbally and visually, with no drift. One unmistakable Joy_, everywhere.
Make it convert. In the end, conversion is what counts. You stay fully data-driven, keep the conversion rates per channel in view, and double down on what actually moves them.
Qualifikation
What makes a good fit.
We're not reading your CV for the logos or the degree. We want to see what you've actually built. Show us the creative things you've already pulled off, whether at a past job or on your own time. That's what we're reading for.

s.h: A few traits make it click
s.t:
You've built a brand before, at least 3 years of it. From near zero, or as a core part of the team, ideally in consumer, retail, or culture, for a brand made to reach everyone, not a narrow niche. You know how a campaign works end to end, and you can run the channels that carry it.
You have taste. For brand, for content, for social, for the zeitgeist. You instinctively sense what fits the narrative and what breaks it, verbally, visually, aesthetically, and you know what the internet finds good this week, not last year.
Social media is your daily life, and you've worked with creators and influencers. You know how social actually works from the inside: what makes a collab feel real, what makes it flop, and how to brief people who live on camera.
Bonus: you've run our growth channels yourself. TV and Out of Home, and above all a TikTok UGC engine you built and steered. If you've already stood up your own creator army and made it perform, that's a massive plus.
You're bold in what you ship. In the ideas and concepts you put out, and in the brand language itself. You want to do things in a way nobody has yet.
You make things yourself. You have taste and hands. You can write the script, cut the reel, and build the Notion doc in the same hour.
Insane agency and ownership. You turn chaos into clarity and you'd rather ship rough than wait for permission.
AI-native instincts. You create videos and creative assets with AI without breaking a sweat. The tools change weekly and you don't care, you bend whatever is newest to make more, faster.
Fluency in German and English is a must.

What's in it for you.
🌱 Ownership. The whole brand and marketing surface is yours, working side by side with the founders every day. Real budget for ideas, including 10% of your time for the remarkable stuff (our Blue Slide principle).
🚀 Growth. Work on the frontier of consumer brand-building alongside senior operators and engineers who've built and scaled before.
💡 Autonomy. Remote-first with the freedom to work how you work best.
🎁 Meaningful equity. We want you to win with us.
🛍️ Real impact. See what you build go live across product, campaigns, and shelves. Fast.
Why this role is truly different.
Most brand jobs are about polishing something that already exists, or squeezing a funnel someone else built. This one is a blank canvas, and it's yours to go wild on.
We're young and we want to be loud. The gift card is dusty, an afterthought, the thing people grab when nothing better came to mind, and nobody has touched it in years. We're the fresh, loud opposite, the brand that flips a tired category on its head and ruffles a few feathers doing it. You get the full creative range to live that out, sitting directly with the co-founders with the whole brand surface yours from day one.
Here's why this role outranks everything else in marketing: Joy_ is bought on occasion, not on inspiration. Nobody wakes up wanting a gift card. People buy when a birthday or a thank-you lands on them, and they reach for whatever name is already in their head. So we have to get there first. That makes brand awareness our single most important channel and our biggest priority , and it comes with real budget .

As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.
Aufgaben

Campaigns & Product Launches

keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables
identifying problems and dependencies early
reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.

Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.

TikTok Shop campaigns and promotions
Seller Center and campaign management
livestream campaigns and activations
product and promotional planning

identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce

which products and topics we should focus on
how we communicate them to our audience
which content formats and channels make sense
how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels
We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better.

s.h: coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team
s.t:
improve workflows and processes

help shape marketing priorities together with the founders
There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.

s.h: Your Role Can Grow With You
s.t:
We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.
Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:
Performance & KPIs
Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.
Marketing Budgets
Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.
CRM & Email Marketing
Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.
What Ownership Means at MAOMAO
Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.
It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.
It means thinking beyond the individual task.
If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.

What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?
Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems .
Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:
What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?
You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.
Not every idea will work. That is okay.
What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.

s.h: The mindset we're looking for is
s.t:
“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.”
